### Copy trading on eToro

About

## From Thessaloniki to 63 countries

I grew up in Thessaloniki and moved to Cardiff at 17 to study Business Management. I ran my first online store as a teenager and co-founded the fintech Blink at university, taking it through incubators in Helsinki, a National Bank of Greece award, Forbes 30 Under 30 and Startupbootcamp in Amsterdam.
Today I invest for the long run on eToro, where more than 2,100 people copy my portfolio. I co-run Blue Banana in Halkidiki and teach entrepreneurship through Innovation Academy. Building companies and investing in them feed each other: the operator in me checks the investor, and the investor keeps the operator honest.

### Milestones

- 2021 Graduated from Cardiff University. Started my public eToro track record in June.
- 2022 Co-founded Blink. University of Helsinki Compass pre-incubator. HarvardX certificate.
- 2023 National Bank of Greece Business Seeds award. 2nd at GSEA Greece. Named to Forbes 30 Under 30 Greece.
- 2024 Raised funding at Startupbootcamp in Amsterdam. Study UK Alumni Awards Global Finalist. Cardiff University 30(ish) Award.
- 2025 Built Blue Banana, the most viral beach bar in Greece. Silver mentor award at GSEA Greece. Passed 1,000 copiers.
- 2026 Passed 2,000 copiers and $2.7M copying my portfolio. Interviews on Naftemporiki TV and leading Greek podcasts.

Contact

Hypothetical only. Nobody knows future returns; they vary from year to year and can be negative, so you can end up with less than you put in. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Fees, taxes and currency moves are not included. This is not investment advice.

## BullAware score: 8.9 out of 10

BullAware is an independent analytics site for eToro investors. Its score from 1 to 10 combines eight risk-adjusted ratios with the length of the track record. Below is what each ratio means and where my portfolio stands over the last three years.
Last 3 years: Nov 2023 to Aug 2026, month-end data, calculated with BullAware's published method.
Other windows Last 2 years · 8.6 Last year · 8.4 2026 so far · 8.3
Verify on BullAware ↗

8.9 / 10 · Last 3 years

Beta
0.39▲ Strong

How much my portfolio moves with the market. 1.0 means it moves like the S&P 500. Lower means calmer swings.
Calmer than the market below 0.8

Sharpe ratio
2.00▲ Strong

Return earned above cash for every unit of risk taken. The classic measure of risk-adjusted return.
Good above 1, very good around 2

Sortino ratio
5.30▲ Strong

Like Sharpe, but it only counts the bad volatility: the months that lose money.
Strong above 2

Jensen's alpha
+21.7%▲ Strong

Yearly return above what the portfolio's market risk alone would predict. Positive means stock picking added value.
Strong above 2%

Omega ratio
1.54▲ Strong

Monthly gains against monthly shortfalls compared with the S&P 500. Above 1 means gains outweigh shortfalls.
Strong above 1.5

Treynor ratio
5.73▲ Strong

Excess return for each unit of market risk (beta). Higher means a better reward for the market risk taken.
Strong above 1.25

Information ratio
0.60◆ Fair

How consistently the portfolio beats the S&P 500, relative to how far it strays from it.
Around 0.5 is top quartile for active managers

Calmar ratio
5.57▲ Strong

Yearly growth divided by the deepest drop. It shows how much return each unit of pain bought.
Good above 1

### eToro risk score: 4 of 10

eToro rates every portfolio daily from 1 (lowest) to 10 (highest), based on how much it moves. Popular Investors must stay at 7 or lower.

Positions: 34 Cash: 6.9% Style: Long-only stocks, global

Method

### How I invest

- Businesses, not tickers. I buy companies I would be happy to own for years and hold them while the thesis holds.
- The LK Index. My own 11-criterion framework scores every company on quality, value and risk before I buy.
- Undervalued and antifragile. I look for businesses that come out of shocks stronger, bought below what I believe they are worth.
- Global and diversified. Positions across the US, Europe, the UK, Australia, Latin America and Asia, with cash always on hand.
- Every move explained. When I buy, I post why. Every month I review what moved, what changed and what I am watching next.

# Copy trading, explained · Konstantinos Kousouris

What copy trading on eToro is, how copying Konstantinos Kousouris works, what it costs, the risks, and a quiz to see whether this investing style fits you.

URL: https://kkonstantinos.com/copytrading.html

Copy trading

# Copy trading, explained

Copy trading lets you put money behind an investor you trust and have your account mirror their decisions automatically. Here is how it works on eToro, what it costs, where the risks are, and a short quiz to see whether my style fits you.

## How copying works

1

### Choose an investor

Every Popular Investor on eToro has a public profile: returns, risk score, holdings and copiers. Mine is Le_kousou.
2

### Pick an amount

From $200. Your money mirrors the portfolio in proportion: if 5% of my portfolio is in a stock, 5% of your copy amount goes there too.
3

### Stay in control

You can pause, add or withdraw funds, or stop copying at any time. Copied trades use eToro's standard fees. You never pay me.

Quiz

## Does copying my portfolio fit you?

Five quick questions. Answer honestly and you get an honest result, not a sales pitch.

Does copying my portfolio fit you?

### Good fit

Your horizon, goals and temperament match the way I invest: long-term, global stocks, bought below what I believe they are worth, with every move explained in a monthly update.
Before you copy, know the swings: the largest drop since January 2023 was 10.9%, and between September 2021 and May 2024 the portfolio fell 33%. Copy only with money you will not need for years, and start with an amount you are comfortable with.
Copy Le_kousou on eToro → Open an eToro account Start over
This quiz is an educational self-check, not investment advice or a personal recommendation. Only you can decide what fits your situation.
Copy Trading is not investment advice | Capital at risk | Past performance does not guarantee future results

Does copying my portfolio fit you?

### Partial fit

Some of your answers match my style and some do not. That usually means one of two things: your horizon is shorter than this portfolio needs, or you want more control than copying gives you.
If you still want to try, start small, read the questions below first, and remember the swings: the largest drop since January 2023 was 10.9%, and in 2021 to 2024 the portfolio fell 33%.
Copy Le_kousou on eToro → Read how copying works Start over

Does copying my portfolio fit you?

### Probably not the right fit, for now

A short horizon, a need for quick gains or discomfort with drops do not match a long-term stock portfolio, and I would rather tell you that than take your copy.
Consider building an emergency fund first, learning the basics, or speaking with a licensed adviser. The questions below explain how copying works whenever you want to come back.

New to eToro?

## How copying works

What is eToro?
A multi-asset investment platform founded in 2007 and listed on Nasdaq under the ticker ETOR. It reports more than 40 million registered users and operates through regulated companies in the EU, the UK, Australia and the US. Regulation and licences ↗
What does copying my portfolio mean?
With eToro's CopyTrader you choose an amount (from $200) and your account mirrors my portfolio automatically, in proportion. You stay in control: pause, add or withdraw funds, or stop copying whenever you want.
What is a Popular Investor?
eToro's program for investors that others can copy, with four levels: Cadet, Champion, Elite and Elite Pro. I am at Elite, which requires at least $400K copying you and an investment qualification. eToro pays Popular Investors based on the assets copying them. Copiers do not pay me. eToro ↗
What does it cost?
Copied trades use eToro's standard fees, the same as the trades you make yourself. Read eToro's fee page before you start. eToro fees ↗
Can I lose money?
Yes. Investments can go down as well as up, copying does not remove risk, and past returns do not guarantee future ones. Only invest money you can afford to lose.
How do I start?
Open an eToro account, search for Le_kousou and press Copy. If you sign up through my link, eToro may offer you a welcome bonus, depending on your country and eToro's terms.

# An investor who builds companies

Building companies taught me how businesses really work: cash, people, customers and timing. I read every company I invest in like an operator.

Pitching Blink at Startupbootcamp, Amsterdam

Co-founder & CEO · 2022-2025 · formerly Blink

### Blinko AI

An AI money assistant that banks could offer young customers under their own brand. We took it from a university idea to a funded fintech.

- University of Helsinki incubators: Compass (2022) and NEXUS (2023)

- Forbes 30 Under 30 Greece, Technology (2024 list)
- Startupbootcamp Inclusive FinTech & DeFi, Amsterdam (2024): selected and funded
